title: Light over the mesa, green light, missing time and Apache helicopters
place_text: Aztec crash site mesa, New Mexico

tellings.quote: Right after we said it was a 90 degree turn [snorts] and we're uh you know and we're walking back down to the rest of the group and uh it it was instantly over us.

plain: A camper who is not named says that on a mesa near Aztec, New Mexico, where a UFO is said to have crashed, a light that had just made a sharp 90-degree turn was suddenly right over his group. He tells Michels that a green light followed, that the group lost a stretch of time they could not account for, and that Apache military helicopters showed up afterwards. He says he was there himself.
